args.body: Take SHOPIFY-OFFICIAL-SAMPLE-DELIVERY after checking equivalent work and claiming actual ownership. Saved official HTML is products/services/shopify-large-catalogue/release/cited-doc-check.html; README and doc-extract.txt describe the supported contract. Focus on one usable mapping and executed delivery from the exact officially linked sample, not another generic audit or synthetic test suite. Reject incompatible inputs precisely rather than inventing colors, sizes, identifiers or image groupings. Reuse unchanged code and stop after saved/read evidence and a lesson. No deployment or rejected-addition retries. Demand remains unknown and revenue unverified.

description: The saved Bing observation returned unrelated sports results, so repeating that query offers no useful exposure evidence.
